summary.allegation: The issuer says the cardholder was charged a 215 EUR no-show fee by Hotel Marais Saint-Paul and disputes that the charge is valid.
summary.to_defend: Mastercard requires the merchant to show the original booking, the no-show or cancellation policy disclosed at booking, evidence the cardholder failed to show or cancelled late, and that the fee charged matches that policy.

requirements.title: Original booking
requirements.text: Evidence of the cardholder's original reservation or booking.
requirements.finding: The booking confirmation identifies reservation MSP-2025-4488 for guest K. Adler, one night Classic Double, check-in 26 April 2025, at 215.00 EUR on Mastercard ending 4421, matching the disputed amount and merchant.

requirements.title: Policy disclosed at booking
requirements.text: The merchant's no-show / cancellation policy as disclosed at booking.
requirements.finding: The cancellation policy shows a non-refundable rate with no refund for no-show, and records tick-box acceptance by the guest on 12 March 2025 at 09:14 CET under consent_id cns_4488a, the same date as the booking.

citations.quote: No refund will be issued for cancellation, modification, no-show, or early departure. This was disclosed and accepted at the time of booking.
Guest accepted this policy on 12 March 2025 at 09:14 CET via tick-box consent on the booking page (consent_id: cns_4488a).

requirements.title: No-show or late cancellation
requirements.text: Evidence the cardholder either failed to show or cancelled outside the policy window.
requirements.finding: The front desk log for booking MSP-2025-4488 records the guest as expected at 15:00 on 26 April 2025, not arrived at 22:00 with no contact, and marked NO-SHOW after the midnight cut-off.

citations.quote:
26 Apr 2025
22:00
Guest not arrived. No contact from guest.
S. Bernard
Room held until midnight cut-off per policy. Marked NO-SHOW.

requirements.title: Fee matches policy
requirements.text: Evidence the fee charged matches the policy disclosed.
requirements.finding: The policy states non-refundable bookings are charged in full with no refund for a no-show, and the amount retained, 215.00 EUR, equals the full room rate on the confirmation and the disputed transaction amount.

citations.quote: Non-refundable bookings are charged in full at the time of booking.
Room released. No-show fee retained per non-refundable T&Cs.

alerts.text: The confirmation says the 215.00 EUR was charged at booking on 12 March 2025, but the disputed transaction is dated 26 April 2025 at 11:00 UTC, before the 15:00 check-in and before the no-show was determined. Confirm the cardholder was not billed twice and that txn_9967QR is the only 215 EUR charge on booking MSP-2025-4488 before filing.

reasons: Evidence conflicts with the claim or the transaction data

justification: All four requirements are met with a matching booking, an accepted non-refundable policy, a contemporaneous no-show log and a fee equal to the disclosed rate.
rationale:
The issuer alleges the 215 EUR no-show fee charged by Hotel Marais Saint-Paul is invalid.
Booking MSP-2025-4488 for K. Adler covers one night from 26 April 2025 at a non-refundable rate of 215.00 EUR on Mastercard ending 4421, matching the disputed amount.
The cancellation policy states no refund for cancellation, modification, no-show or early departure, and was accepted by tick-box consent on 12 March 2025 at 09:14 CET under consent_id cns_4488a.
The front desk log shows the guest had not arrived at 22:00 on 26 April 2025, was marked NO-SHOW after the midnight cut-off and the room was released at 07:15 on 27 April 2025.
The charge authenticated through 3DS with AVS Y and CVV M, and the amount retained equals the full disclosed rate, so the fee matches the policy; confirm internally that the 26 April charge is the only debit for this booking before submission.
